readiness_criteria.name: The Hand-Deep Puddle Drainage Test
readiness_criteria.method: Scoop out a hole one hand-depth deep in the new bed. Fill to the brim with clean water. Count your walking paces or breathe calmly.
readiness_criteria.pass_condition: Water drains completely away within the time it takes to walk 500 calm paces (approx 5 to 10 minutes).
readiness_criteria.fail_condition: Water sits stagnating in a cold muddy puddle after 1,000 paces.
readiness_criteria.fail_fix: Bed has compacted or bottom drainage holes/wood spaces are clogged. Poke deep vertical aeration holes with a thumb-thick pointed stick and incorporate another bucketful of dry crumbled leaves and coarse wood charcoal.

readiness_criteria.name: The Compost Fever Check
readiness_criteria.method: Bury your hand forearm-deep into the center of the newly built bed.
readiness_criteria.pass_condition: The soil feels cool, pleasant, or gently warm like sun-warmed river stones.
readiness_criteria.fail_condition: The soil feels hot, steaming, or like a fever to the back of your hand.
readiness_criteria.fail_fix: Fresh organic matter is in active microbial hot fermentation. Sowing now will scald and kill delicate seedling roots. Wait 5 to 7 sun cycles and recheck before planting.

readiness_criteria.name: The Root Depth Clearance Check
readiness_criteria.method: Push a straight stick straight down until it hits the barrier layer (cardboard/burlap/rock base). Mark the depth with your thumb and measure against your body.
readiness_criteria.pass_condition: Depth is at least knee-high (~45 cm) for heavy feeders or hand-to-elbow deep (~30 cm) for shallow greens and bush beans.
readiness_criteria.fail_condition: Depth is less than one hand-span (~15 cm).
readiness_criteria.fail_fix: Add more stone height to retaining perimeter and dump another 2 bucketfuls of clean compost and leaf-mold.

readiness_criteria.name: The Toxin Barrier Seal Check
readiness_criteria.method: Walk the perimeter of the bed and inspect the base edges where stones meet raw ground.
readiness_criteria.pass_condition: Cardboard or canvas overlaps smoothly with zero raw stained dirt visible inside the bed; no oily seepage creeping up.
readiness_criteria.fail_condition: Raw stained dirt or chemical water is oozing into the lower layer of the bed.
readiness_criteria.fail_fix: Pack a thumb-thick layer of dry wood ash and crushed charcoal along the inner rim, then lay an extra layer of wet canvas before refilling.

readiness_criteria.name: The 5-Seed Canary Sprout Check
readiness_criteria.method: Sow 5 quick-sprouting test seeds (beans or cress) in a corner of the bed. Water lightly for 4 to 6 suns.
readiness_criteria.pass_condition: At least 4 seeds sprout with healthy green leaves standing upright.
readiness_criteria.fail_condition: Seeds rot or emerge yellow, curled, and blackened.
readiness_criteria.fail_fix: Substrate is too acidic, salty, or waterlogged. Sprinkle cold hardwood ashes lightly and aerate.
